No plain-DXVK job (Rodney 2026-11-15: every game test runs on Apex + the RTX Remix bridge; the in-process GPU guard is proved by the toy selftest only, case refusals). Flags (Rodney 2026-11-15): every job passes --allow-audio --reap-workers --recreate-views. RUN FIRST after chain-reruns-1115 (docs/270 §10). Game smoke of the rewind tool (tools/harness/rewind, test-only, game-copy test install only). Before the queue: tools\harness\rewind\build.cmd (builds out\rewind-spike.exe, toy selftest must say PASS). Each job loads Baseline-BP-Spring and runs tools/harness/rewind-smoke.ts, which pauses the game through the agent, drives `rewind-spike serve` on TS3W.exe and plays on 20 s to see the game still answers. Jobs go from harmless to invasive, the queue stops at the first FAIL: (1) plan: nothing is written into the game, lists what a rewind would do and every reason it would refuse; (2) plan-probe: plus the one-byte view probe; (3) strict: a real snapshot and rewind with the shared-view and window guards on (audio, workers, unpinned views allowed), a refusal is a valid result. Sound: devices stay open (mute only), so --allow-audio is passed; a real sound-off is open research (docs/270 §7). Probe: queue.ts always attaches the Frida probe, so the jobs pass --allow-module frida-agent; a clean rewind job needs the probe detached (docs/270 §9). Correctness only, no timing. Rows: probe-out/rewind/smoke-1115-<mode>.jsonl, judged by hand into docs/270 §10. node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/rewind-smoke-1115.json --no-smoke
